name: Haus Steissbach
beschreibung: The Haus Steissbach is quietly and sunnily situated on Mooserweg in St. Anton am Arlberg. The stylishly appointed holiday flats offer plenty of space for families and independent travellers, featuring fully equipped kitchens with high-grade appliances, comfortable living lounges, restful bedrooms, Wi-Fi, and private balconies framing views of the rugged Arlberg peaks. A landscaped garden and on-site parking add to the convenience. Its premier location places guests just a short stroll from the base stations of the Galzig and Gampen gondolas, as well as St. Anton's vibrant village centre with its shops and eateries. In winter, visitors enjoy fast access to the pistes of Ski Arlberg, while summer invites exploration into the scenic Verwall Valley.
kurzbeschreibung: Comfortable holiday flats on Mooserweg in St. Anton am Arlberg in a quiet setting with fully fitted kitchens and near the Gampenbahn.
